s1.syndrome_frame: Pelvic mass with pelvic pain and urinary frequency
salient_findings: Heterogeneous 9.4 cm lesion involving the right uterine fundus/cornua
Mass in the right retroperitoneal space encasing the right external iliac artery
key_facts: 54-year-old woman
History of stage III invasive ductal breast carcinoma
Treated with mastectomy and chemoradiation 4 years earlier
Presenting with urinary frequency
Worsening right-sided pelvic pain
Weight loss
MRI of the pelvis showed multiple fibroids and a heterogeneous 9.4 cm lesion
Mass involved the right uterine fundus/cornua
Mass was in the right retroperitoneal space
Mass encased the right external iliac artery
Specimen was a detached, fragmented, ill-defined mass
Specimen had fleshy solid and cystic components
Specimen had central hemorrhage and necrosis
Tumor invaded from the serosal surface into the myometrium
Tumor comprised sheets of small, round hyperchromatic cells
High nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios
Frequent mitoses
Pseudo-rosette formation
Foci of cytoplasmic clearing
Necrosis

shortlist.label: Uterine leiomyosarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: High-grade tumor with frequent mitoses and necrosis, consistent with leiomyosarcoma

shortlist.label: Ewing sarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: Small, round, hyperchromatic cells with pseudo-rosette formation, consistent with Ewing sarcoma

shortlist.label: Desmoplastic small round cell tumor
shortlist.why_kept: Small, round, hyperchromatic cells with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, consistent with desmoplastic small round cell tumor

shortlist.label: Undifferentiated uterine sarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: Undifferentiated tumor with high-grade features, consistent with undifferentiated uterine sarcoma

shortlist.label: Breast cancer metastasis
shortlist.why_kept: History of stage III invasive ductal breast carcinoma, with possibility of metastasis to the uterus

raw.rationale: The tumor's microscopic features, including sheets of small, round hyperchromatic cells with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, frequent mitoses, pseudo-rosette formation, and positivity for CD99, are characteristic of desmoplastic small round cell tumor.

rejected.label: Uterine leiomyosarcoma
rejected.why: The tumor's microscopic features do not match those of leiomyosarcoma, which typically consists of spindle cells with a high degree of atypia.

rejected.label: Ewing sarcoma
rejected.why: While Ewing sarcoma can also express CD99, the clinical presentation and tumor location are not typical for Ewing sarcoma, which usually occurs in the bones or soft tissues of the extremities.

rejected.label: Undifferentiated uterine sarcoma
rejected.why: The tumor's microscopic features are more specific and characteristic of desmoplastic small round cell tumor than undifferentiated uterine sarcoma, which is a diagnosis of exclusion.

rejected.label: Breast cancer metastasis
rejected.why: The tumor's microscopic features and immunohistochemical profile do not match those of breast cancer, and the patient's history of breast cancer does not necessarily imply a metastasis to the uterus.
